verdict.rationale: Docs mention generically that developers can 'simulate test purchases before going live' in the Issuing sandbox, implying some lifecycle testing capability, but the evidence pack gives no detail on simulating authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, or declines specifically. missing for 10: documented test-helper endpoints for each lifecycle stage (auth, capture, reversal, refund, decline), independent/hands-on confirmation that sandbox simulation covers the full lifecycle.
